question: do reported earnings and cash reflect economic reality?

earnings_versus_cash.finding: Over the trailing four quarters operating cash flow is {earnings_versus_cash.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} times net income. Cash still exceeds reported income, but this is the thinnest cover on record: every fiscal year in the history is higher, fiscal 2025 {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}, fiscal 2024 {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.1.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}, fiscal 2023 {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.2.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}, fiscal 2022 {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.3.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}, fiscal 2021 {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.4.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} and fiscal 2020 {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.5.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}. Accruals over average assets are {earnings_versus_cash.accruals_over_average_assets|pct}. That is still negative, so cash is above income, but it is closer to zero than any filed year in the trend table: fiscal 2025 {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.accruals_over_total_assets|pct}, fiscal 2024 {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.accruals_over_total_assets|pct}, fiscal 2023 {trend_table.years-back-2.ratios.accruals_over_total_assets|pct}, fiscal 2022 {trend_table.years-back-3.ratios.accruals_over_total_assets|pct}, fiscal 2021 {trend_table.years-back-4.ratios.accruals_over_total_assets|pct}. The table divides by period-end assets rather than average assets and switches between ProfitLoss and NetIncomeLoss across years, so this comparison shows direction only. The quarterly accrual cell is not filled for this quarter. Income is now growing faster than cash. This quarter's net income rose {ratios.growth.net_income.year_over_year|pct} on the year-ago quarter while operating cash flow rose {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.year_over_year|pct}; over the trailing four quarters the two grew {ratios.growth.net_income.trailing_four_quarters|pct} and {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.trailing_four_quarters|pct}. In the quarter itself operating cash flow {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.this_quarter} still exceeds net income {ratios.growth.net_income.this_quarter}. Part of the decline is mechanical and benign. Depreciation and amortization, mostly of acquisition intangibles, is a non-cash charge and was flat year to date ({terms.trailing_four_quarters.depreciation_and_amortization.parts.this_year_to_date.value} against {terms.trailing_four_quarters.depreciation_and_amortization.parts.prior_year_to_date.value}), so as income grows past it, cash and income move toward parity. The rest is working capital. The receivables increase {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.balance_sheet_change} equals {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.share_of_net_income|pct} of trailing net income and inventory {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.share_of_net_income|pct}, while the payables increase gives back {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.share_of_net_income|pct}. The statements articulate. The gap between the balance-sheet change and the cash-flow statement's change is {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.articulation_gap} for receivables, {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.articulation_gap} for inventory and {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.articulation_gap} for payables. Neither report explains the payables gap; a benign reading is payables for capital spending, which the operating section leaves out. Smoothness is {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness}. That is above one, so income moves more than cash and there is no sign of smoothing; much of it comes from the oldest quarter in the series, a loss of {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness.net_income.8} while cash stayed positive. MD&A's own account is that operating cash flow rose on higher income and non-cash charges, "offset in part by $2,805 million from changes in operating assets and liabilities." These numbers agree with it. No adjustment is written: the receivables build is already charged against operating cash flow, and the prose ties it to collection timing, not to extended terms.
earnings_versus_cash.verdict: Weaker than the company's own history. Cash still covers income, but by the narrowest margin on file, and income is growing faster than cash, with receivables doing most of the absorbing. Part of the slide is a large, flat non-cash amortization charge fading against growing income; the rest is working capital.

revenue_recognition.finding: Receivables are outrunning revenue. Days sales outstanding over the trailing four quarters are {ratios.efficiency.days_sales_outstanding}. For the quarter they are {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}, against {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} a year earlier and {trend_table.quarters-back-6.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} at the start of the table, behind only the prior quarter's {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}. Fiscal 2025's {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} was the "highest of the 5 filled years", against {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} in fiscal 2024 and {trend_table.years-back-4.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} in fiscal 2021. Receivables stand at {terms.balances_now.receivables}, against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.receivables} a year earlier, while quarterly revenue grew {ratios.growth.revenue.year_over_year|pct}. MD&A says the increase is "primarily due to higher semiconductor revenue and the timing of collections". Higher revenue alone does not lengthen days outstanding, so collection timing carries the weight. These days are measured after non-recourse factoring, and the note gives a year-to-date factoring volume below the prior year's, so part of the rise may be less factoring rather than slower customers. The prose does not say. Contract liabilities are moving against revenue. Current contract liabilities over quarterly revenue fell to {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue|pct}, the lowest of the filled quarters, from {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue|pct} the quarter before and {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue|pct} a year earlier. The balance, {terms.balances_now.contract_liabilities}, is below the year-earlier {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.contract_liabilities} even as revenue rises. The filing's explanation is a substantive change in contract terms: "As of the fiscal quarter ended August 2, 2026, we no longer have termination for convenience provisions for the majority of new software contracts." Licences on those contracts are recognized upfront at transfer of control instead of over the term. The note now reports "we included upfront license revenue of $3,465 million and $7,184 million, respectively, within products revenue", above the prior-year amounts it gives, and MD&A credits this for part of software revenue and operating income growth. The stated policy is unchanged, but revenue now lands earlier relative to billing and cash. The contract-balance policy wording also changed. The sentence "A contract asset is a right to consideration that is conditional on something other than the passage of time." was removed, and changes are now tied to "billing the customer" rather than to payment. Meanwhile MD&A says software contract assets, which are revenue recognized but not yet invoiced, increased. Remaining performance obligations rose while the share expected within the next year was cut: "We expect approximately 25% of this amount to be recognized as revenue over the next 12 months." There is also a new judgment area. The notes do not say how the Backstop or the customer notes bear on the transaction price or collectability of the related product sales, which leaves open whether part of the price is consideration payable to a customer. The tagged major customer's share of receivables in fiscal 2025 ({concentration.facts.4.value|pct}) exceeds its share of revenue ({concentration.facts.3.value|pct}). Fourth-quarter concentration cannot be tested: no fiscal fourth quarter has a cell in the trend table, and the derivation is not in my inputs, even though the guidance points to a large fourth quarter. Bill-and-hold and explicitly extended payment terms: nothing found, because neither report mentions them.
revenue_recognition.verdict: Not clean. Compared with the company's own past, revenue is being recognized earlier relative to billing and collection: receivable days are near a multi-year high, contract liabilities are falling as revenue rises, and a contract-term change moves software licence revenue to upfront recognition. Each has a stated, GAAP-consistent explanation; together they mean reported revenue growth runs ahead of cash.

estimates_and_reserves.finding: Reserve ratios: nothing found, for want of data. The record tags no allowance for credit losses, no inventory valuation reserve and no warranty accrual in any period, so no ratio and no thinning can be measured. This is a gap in the data, not a clean result. Goodwill headroom and discount-rate or growth assumptions: neither report carries them, so nothing found. The largest new estimate is the Backstop. Management says "The fair value of the Backstop was not material.", against a tagged maximum of {terms.balances_now.guarantee_maximum_exposure}, undiscounted and reached once all racks are deployed. The filing gives no valuation approach or inputs, and MD&A still says "There were no significant changes in our critical accounting estimates during the three fiscal quarters ended August 2, 2026". An immaterial fair value keeps any guarantee charge out of earnings. Whether that is right depends on the customer's default risk, and MD&A itself describes customers whose current cash flows fall short of their investment needs. Tax: the trailing effective rate is {tax_rate.effective_rate|pct}. It is held low partly because the trailing window includes fiscal 2025, whose provision was a net benefit of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.income_tax_expense.parts.prior_fiscal_year.value}. My reports do not say whether that benefit came from discrete items or a valuation-allowance release, and the fiscal 2025 tax holiday is tagged for that one year only. The year-to-date provision rose to {terms.trailing_four_quarters.income_tax_expense.parts.this_year_to_date.value} from {terms.trailing_four_quarters.income_tax_expense.parts.prior_year_to_date.value}, on pretax income of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.pretax_income.parts.this_year_to_date.value} against {terms.trailing_four_quarters.pretax_income.parts.prior_year_to_date.value}. Both the note and MD&A say the rise "was primarily due to higher income before income taxes." Neither mentions the global minimum tax, yet a new footnote reads "(a) Included $2,186 million global minimum tax payable as of August 2, 2026." The trailing rate is therefore a poor guide to the rate ahead. One estimate change raised income: "we had a $315 million gain from the reversal of excise tax charges on our acquisition of VMware", in year-to-date other income, which the release excludes from non-GAAP. The calculator has no field for its amount, so no earnings adjustment is written. Cutting the near-term share of the backlog lowers expected near-term revenue and does not raise income.
estimates_and_reserves.verdict: Caution. The period's largest judgment, an immaterial fair value for a guarantee with a very large maximum, is unquantified. The trailing tax rate leans on a prior-year benefit while a minimum tax is arriving. One reversal raised year-to-date income. The reserve ratios cannot be tested at all.

cost_deferral.finding: Capitalized cost: nothing found. The record tags no capitalized software additions, research and development is expensed, and year-to-date research and development expense rose ({terms.trailing_four_quarters.research_and_development_expense.parts.this_year_to_date.value} against {terms.trailing_four_quarters.research_and_development_expense.parts.prior_year_to_date.value}). MD&A attributes the rise mainly to stock-based compensation from the two-year grant. Nothing suggests cost is being moved onto the balance sheet. Soft assets are falling, not rising. The soft-asset share is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share|pct}, the "lowest of the 6 filled quarters", against {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.soft_asset_share|pct} at the end of fiscal 2024, as acquisition intangibles amortize and cash builds to {terms.balances_now.cash}. Items treated as non-recurring do recur. Restructuring and impairment charges are tagged in this quarter, the year-ago quarter and both year-to-date periods, and the release adds them back to non-GAAP income each time. The VMware integration is the benign reading, but a charge present in every period read is an operating cost. The gap between non-GAAP and GAAP earnings cannot be measured or trended: no us-gaap concept carries a non-GAAP figure, so the calculator's non_gaap_gap is missing in every period. The release's non-GAAP earnings exclude stock-based compensation, a real cost that free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted already subtracts ({terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation}). Costs related to upfront licences are described as immaterial, so the shift to upfront recognition does not bring a deferred-cost asset with it.
cost_deferral.verdict: Largely clean: no cost is visibly being capitalized and soft assets are shrinking. The caveats are restructuring charges that recur in every period read and a non-GAAP gap that cannot be measured.

cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh.finding: Off-balance-sheet exposure has grown sharply. First, a new guarantee. The Backstop of a customer's AI-rack lease payments carries a tagged maximum exposure of {terms.balances_now.guarantee_maximum_exposure}, and no value is tagged at the year-earlier balance date. The company owes "any difference between 85% of the outstanding amounts owed on the lease Backstop and the value of the AI racks received upon sale of the assets at that time". One remedy, assuming the lease, would put the company in the lessee's position; another resells the racks to an unnamed seller at a fixed price. MD&A adds: "In addition, we have provided a backstop and may continue to enter into similar financing arrangements, which increases our exposure to counterparty credit risk." Second, a route to vendor financing: "our customer may, under certain circumstances and if needed, issue to us convertible promissory notes up to an aggregate principal amount of $42 billion". None had been issued at quarter end. If notes are issued, company cash would leave through investing while the related product receipts arrive through operating, which would flatter operating cash flow. Nothing has moved yet, and this period's cash-flow statement shows no classification shift. Third, purchase obligations. Unrecorded unconditional purchase obligations are {terms.balances_now.unconditional_purchase_obligations} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.unconditional_purchase_obligations} a year earlier, which is larger than trailing cost of revenue of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.cost_of_revenue}. Neither report explains them. Fourth, factoring. Proceeds from non-recourse factoring sit in operating cash flow: "Total trade accounts receivable sold under the factoring arrangements were $1,600 million and $3,950 million during the fiscal quarter and three fiscal quarters ended August 2, 2026". The year-to-date volume is below the prior year's, so factoring is not what lifts this year's cash growth. The concept is untagged, so the field terms.trailing_four_quarters.proceeds_from_sale_of_receivables is missing and no amount can be measured or adjusted. Supplier finance: terms.balances_now.supplier_finance_obligation is missing and neither report mentions a programme, so nothing found. Leases: no current lease liability is tagged; the newest filed balance is {ratios.solvency.operating_lease_liability}. Variable-interest entities: neither report says whether the financial partner's rack-owning arrangement was assessed as one, so nothing found, but it cannot be ruled out. Share-based compensation is {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation} over the trailing four quarters, against {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.share_based_compensation} in fiscal 2025, {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.1.share_based_compensation} in fiscal 2024 and {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.2.share_based_compensation} in fiscal 2023. It is a real cost and is already subtracted in free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted ({free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted}, against simple free cash flow of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_simple}). Withholding taxes on vesting are now settled by selling part of the vested shares instead of paying cash, which moves that cost from a financing outflow to dilution. Adjustments: none. The guarantee field is an undiscounted maximum, not a cash flow or an expected loss, and applying it whole would book the worst case as certain. The factoring and customer-note amounts have no calculator field. The purchase obligations are future purchases, not this period's cash.
cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh.verdict: Adverse. A large new guarantee, a purchase-commitment balance far above its own past, and a contingent route to vendor financing now sit outside the balance sheet. Reported operating cash flow shows no classification shift yet, and factoring is shrinking rather than growing.

controls_audit_and_filing_signals.finding: Nothing adverse is visible, but what is visible is incomplete. The controls item again concludes that disclosure controls are effective and that internal control over financial reporting did not change, this time for the quarter in which the Backstop was entered. A 10-Q carries no auditor's report, so no auditor change, critical audit matter or material weakness can be read. No late-filing notification appears on or before the 10-Q's filing date. Prior balances re-reported in the 10-Q (cash, receivables, inventory, other current assets and current assets at fiscal 2025 year-end) carry the same figures, so no quiet restatement is found, though the numbers reader read only part of the fact file. The filed annual history moves net income between ProfitLoss and NetIncomeLoss across years, and the interest-expense tag differs between the fiscal year and the year-to-date periods. These are tag changes, not restatements, but they break the accrual trend. Officer changes: the 8-K list includes officer-or-director-change filings in March 2026 and April 2026 and other-events filings in June 2026 and July 2026, and their bodies are not in my inputs. So a departure of the chief financial officer, chief accounting officer or controller cannot be ruled out; the 10-Q does show the chief financial officer in office, adopting a trading plan in the quarter. Disclosure signals: the Backstop moved from subsequent events into a new guarantee heading, and its counterparty was renamed from 'investor partner' to 'financial partner'. Related-party growth, subsidiary-list changes and SEC comment letters are not in my inputs, so nothing found.
controls_audit_and_filing_signals.verdict: Clean on what is visible: disclosure controls effective, no late filing, no restatement found. Incomplete, because the officer-change 8-K bodies are not in the inputs.

cross_document_reconciliation.finding: The 8-K release matches the 10-Q on every figure the calculator can check. Quarterly revenue is {ratios.growth.revenue.this_quarter}, with growth of {ratios.growth.revenue.year_over_year|pct}; the release says "up 86 percent from the prior year period". Net income is {ratios.growth.net_income.this_quarter}. Operating income growth is {ratios.growth.operating_income.year_over_year|pct}, against the release's "+171%". Quarterly operating cash flow is {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.this_quarter}; the calculator derives it from the year-to-date and first-half figures, and it equals the release's figure. Cash is {terms.balances_now.cash}. Where the documents differ is disclosure. The release says nothing about the AI XPV platform, the Backstop, the customer notes or counterparty credit risk, while the 10-Q tags {terms.balances_now.guarantee_maximum_exposure} of guarantee exposure. MD&A also says more than the notes: it describes a platform sized in gigawatts, an initial tranche, and possible residual value guarantees that the commitments note does not mention. The segment-axis research and development and SG&A facts carry the release's non-GAAP amounts rather than the GAAP lines. The tax explanation in both the note and MD&A leaves out the new global minimum tax payable. Of the notes reader's items that carry a direction, the numbers confirm those on rising counterparty exposure, the move to upfront licence revenue, rising receivables, inventory and payables, the higher tax provision, the quarter's lower stock-based compensation, higher year-to-date research and development, higher gross margin dollars, lower debt, lower interest expense and higher capital spending. They leave unresolved those on the Backstop's growth, the platform's size and tranche, residual value guarantees, the share of contract liabilities subject to termination, other current assets and liabilities, the minimum tax payable, the quarter's research and SG&A decreases, segment and AI revenue, the mix drag on margin, withholding cash flows and the guidance. They contradict none.
cross_document_reconciliation.verdict: The numbers reconcile between the release and the 10-Q; the disclosure does not, because the release omits the off-balance-sheet structure the 10-Q describes.

industry_lens.finding: Circular or vendor-financed deals: found. The notes say "we arranged for a financial partner to take on certain agreements to purchase AI racks based on custom AI accelerators designed by us and the related lease agreements with a customer that enable access to compute capacity." The company backstops that customer's lease payments up to {terms.balances_now.guarantee_maximum_exposure}. The customer may issue the company convertible notes subject to "the requirement to use the notes or proceeds from the notes, if any, solely for the customer", which the notes reader reads as the customer's lease obligations. MD&A says "The AI XPV platform bridges the gap between the current cash flows of the leading frontier AI labs and significant upfront investments required for their businesses." Demand for the company's accelerators therefore rests partly on the company's own credit, and the platform is meant "to enable more than 20 gigawatts in compute capacity". The reports do not say how much of this period's revenue relates to these racks, and no cash has moved under the Backstop or the notes. Customer concentration: rising. The tagged major customer's share of revenue went from {concentration.facts.0.value|pct} in fiscal 2023 to {concentration.facts.1.value|pct} in fiscal 2024 and {concentration.facts.3.value|pct} in fiscal 2025. Its share of receivables went from {concentration.facts.2.value|pct} to {concentration.facts.4.value|pct}, larger than its revenue share. MD&A now says "Direct sales to one semiconductor solutions customer, which is a distributor, accounted for 50% and 46% of our net revenue" and "We believe aggregate sales to our top five end customers, through all channels, accounted for approximately 55% and 50% of our net revenue". Channel stuffing: unresolved. A distributor taking a rising share of revenue while receivable days sit near their high ({trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}) is the pattern to watch. But neither report gives distributor inventory, sell-through, price protection or return rights, so nothing beyond the pattern is found. Inventory obsolescence: inventory is {terms.balances_now.inventory} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.inventory} a year earlier, built "primarily to support higher expected shipments for AI-related semiconductor solutions", that is, ahead of orders. Quarterly days of inventory, {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory}, are below the prior quarter's {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory} but above the year-ago {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory}. No inventory reserve or write-down is tagged, so obsolescence cannot be tested. Purchase commitments in excess of need: unrecorded purchase obligations are {terms.balances_now.unconditional_purchase_obligations}, against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.unconditional_purchase_obligations} a year earlier and against trailing cost of revenue of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.cost_of_revenue}, and most fall in the first and second years of the tagged schedule. Neither report explains them or says whether any relate to the rack-purchase agreements. If the financed deployments slip, this is where the loss would sit.
industry_lens.verdict: Adverse. A vendor-financed structure supports part of demand, customer and receivable concentration is rising, and inventory and purchase commitments are being built ahead of orders. None has yet produced a loss or a cash outflow.

The only tagged figure is the undiscounted maximum {terms.balances_now.guarantee_maximum_exposure}, at a single date. No outstanding Backstop amount is tagged at any date, so growth with deployment cannot be seen yet.
No tagged number carries the resale price, the seller or the conditions.
The calculator holds the maximum exposure {terms.balances_now.guarantee_maximum_exposure} but no recognized guarantee liability, so the 'not material' judgment cannot be checked.
No notes receivable or related commitment is tagged, and none had been issued at quarter end.

Purchase obligations of {terms.balances_now.unconditional_purchase_obligations}, against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.unconditional_purchase_obligations} a year earlier, and the AI revenue outlook point the same way. But no number measures the platform's deployments, which lie in the future.

Contract liabilities over revenue fell to {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue|pct}, the lowest of the filled quarters, which fits more licence revenue being recognized upfront instead of deferred.

Year to date, receivables ({earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.cash_flow_statement_change.parts.this_year_to_date.value}) and inventory ({earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.cash_flow_statement_change.parts.this_year_to_date.value}) absorbed cash and payables supplied some, so the offset runs in the stated direction.

The calculator computes no year-to-date rate, so whether a higher rate also contributed is not measured.
The provision is tagged, but the minimum tax component is not.
Total current liabilities rose from {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.current_liabilities} to {terms.balances_now.current_liabilities}, but income tax payable is not reported separately.
The tagged quarterly expense is below the same quarter a year earlier.
The expense is tagged, but no number tests the vesting period.
The calculator has no GAAP research and development figure for the year-ago quarter.

Year-to-date research and development was {terms.trailing_four_quarters.research_and_development_expense.parts.this_year_to_date.value} against {terms.trailing_four_quarters.research_and_development_expense.parts.prior_year_to_date.value}.
No GAAP SG&A figure is in the calculator.
Total revenue grew {ratios.growth.revenue.year_over_year|pct}, but the calculator has no segment revenue, and AI revenue appears only in the release.

Revenue rose {ratios.growth.revenue.year_over_year|pct} and the quarterly gross margin rose to {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.gross_margin|pct} from {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.gross_margin|pct} a year earlier, so gross margin dollars rose.

The quarterly margin dipped from {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.gross_margin|pct} to {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.gross_margin|pct} as revenue grew, which fits a mix drag, but the mix effect itself is not reported separately.
The gain is not in the calculator.

Total debt is {ratios.solvency.total_debt} against {terms.debt_a_year_earlier} a year earlier, and year-to-date repayments of {terms.cash_flow_families.borrowing_repaid.parts.this_year_to_date.value} exceed issuance of {terms.cash_flow_families.borrowing_issued.parts.this_year_to_date.value}.

Year-to-date interest expense was {terms.trailing_four_quarters.interest_expense.parts.this_year_to_date.value} against {terms.trailing_four_quarters.interest_expense.parts.prior_year_to_date.value}, on the same tag.
The calculator carries no withholding-tax payment line.

Year-to-date capital expenditure was {terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure.parts.this_year_to_date.value} against {terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure.parts.prior_year_to_date.value}; short-term investments are not tagged.
No number bears on the macro-risk wording.
No number bears on the trading plan.
The guidance is for a future quarter, and the fiscal fourth quarter has no cell in the trend table.
The calculator computes no non-GAAP figure, and the guidance is for a future quarter.
AI revenue is untagged, and the outlook is for a future quarter.
The calculator computes no non-GAAP figure, and the year-ago fourth quarter has no cell.

anomalies.name: Operating cash flow over net income at its lowest on record
anomalies.name_ko: 영업현금흐름 대비 순이익 비율 사상 최저
anomalies.what: Trailing operating cash flow is {earnings_versus_cash.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} times net income, below every fiscal year on record. The nearest is fiscal 2025 at {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}; fiscal 2024 was {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.1.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}. Cash still exceeds income. Benign reading: income is growing past a flat non-cash amortization charge, so cash and income move toward parity. MD&A's account, higher income offset in part by working capital, agrees.

anomalies.name: Accruals closer to zero than any filed year
anomalies.name_ko: 발생액 비율이 과거 어느 해보다 0에 근접
anomalies.what: Accruals over average assets are {earnings_versus_cash.accruals_over_average_assets|pct}: still negative, but closer to zero than any filed year (fiscal 2025 {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.accruals_over_total_assets|pct}, fiscal 2021 {trend_table.years-back-4.ratios.accruals_over_total_assets|pct}). The table uses period-end assets and changes the net-income tag across years, and the quarterly cell is unfilled, so the comparison shows direction only.

anomalies.name: Net income growing faster than operating cash flow
anomalies.name_ko: 순이익 증가율이 영업현금흐름 증가율을 앞섬
anomalies.what: Quarterly net income rose {ratios.growth.net_income.year_over_year|pct} on the year-ago quarter, against {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.year_over_year|pct} for operating cash flow. Over the trailing four quarters the figures are {ratios.growth.net_income.trailing_four_quarters|pct} and {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.trailing_four_quarters|pct}. In the quarter, cash ({ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.this_quarter}) still exceeds income ({ratios.growth.net_income.this_quarter}).

anomalies.name: Receivables build absorbs the largest share of income
anomalies.name_ko: 매출채권 증가가 이익의 가장 큰 몫을 흡수
anomalies.what: The receivables increase of {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.balance_sheet_change} equals {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.share_of_net_income|pct} of trailing net income, against {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.share_of_net_income|pct} for inventory, while payables give back {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.share_of_net_income|pct}. MD&A cites revenue and collection timing.

anomalies.name: Payables change on the balance sheet exceeds the cash-flow statement's
anomalies.name_ko: 재무상태표와 현금흐름표의 매입채무 변동 차이
anomalies.what: The balance-sheet change in payables ({earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.balance_sheet_change}) exceeds the cash-flow statement's change by {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.articulation_gap}. The receivables gap is {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.articulation_gap} and the inventory gap {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.articulation_gap}. The gap is small but unexplained; a benign reading is payables for capital spending, which the operating section leaves out.

anomalies.name: Days sales outstanding near a multi-year high
anomalies.name_ko: 매출채권 회수일수가 수년래 최고 수준
anomalies.what: Quarterly days sales outstanding are {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}, against {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} a year earlier and {trend_table.quarters-back-6.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} at the table's start. Fiscal 2025's {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} was the highest filed year. MD&A's collection-timing explanation fits a rise in days; its revenue explanation does not. Lower factoring year to date may account for part of the rise, which the prose does not say.

anomalies.name: Contract liabilities falling as revenue rises
anomalies.name_ko: 매출 증가 속 계약부채 감소
anomalies.what: Contract liabilities over quarterly revenue fell to {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue|pct}, the lowest of the filled quarters, from {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue|pct} a year earlier. The balance fell from {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.contract_liabilities} to {terms.balances_now.contract_liabilities} while revenue grew {ratios.growth.revenue.year_over_year|pct}. The removal of termination-for-convenience provisions explains it.

anomalies.name: Software licence revenue moved to upfront recognition by a contract-term change
anomalies.name_ko: 계약조건 변경으로 소프트웨어 라이선스 매출을 일시 인식
anomalies.what: Most new software contracts no longer carry termination for convenience, so their licences are recognized upfront at transfer of control rather than over the term. Upfront licence revenue in products revenue rose above the prior-year amounts, and MD&A credits it for part of software growth. Revenue now lands earlier relative to billing and cash, and the share of contract liabilities subject to termination fell.

anomalies.name: Contract-asset policy wording changed while software contract assets rose
anomalies.name_ko: 소프트웨어 계약자산 증가 속 계약자산 정책 문구 변경
anomalies.what: The sentence defining a contract asset as conditional on something other than the passage of time was removed. Contract-balance changes are now tied to billing rather than payment, and MD&A says software contract assets increased. The calculator has no contract-asset balance, so the size of unbilled revenue cannot be followed.

anomalies.name: Backstop's bearing on transaction price and collectability not stated
anomalies.name_ko: 보증이 거래가격·회수가능성에 미치는 영향 미공시
anomalies.what: The company guarantees a customer's lease payments for racks built on its accelerators and may hold that customer's notes. Yet the notes do not say how this bears on the transaction price or collectability of the related product sales, or how much revenue relates to these racks.

anomalies.name: Major customer's share of receivables above its share of revenue
anomalies.name_ko: 주요 고객의 매출채권 비중이 매출 비중을 상회
anomalies.what: The tagged major customer held {concentration.facts.4.value|pct} of receivables in fiscal 2025 against {concentration.facts.3.value|pct} of revenue; in fiscal 2024 the figures were {concentration.facts.2.value|pct} and {concentration.facts.1.value|pct}. Receivables from that customer are growing faster than its revenue.

anomalies.name: Guarantee fair value judged not material against a very large maximum
anomalies.name_ko: 막대한 최대 노출액에도 보증 공정가치를 '중요하지 않음'으로 판단
anomalies.what: Management judged the Backstop's fair value not material against a tagged maximum of {terms.balances_now.guarantee_maximum_exposure}, gave no valuation inputs, and still reports no significant change in critical estimates. The immaterial value keeps a guarantee charge out of earnings.

anomalies.name: Low trailing tax rate rests on a prior-year benefit; minimum tax omitted from the explanation
anomalies.name_ko: 낮은 유효세율이 전년도 세금 환급에 기대고, 최저한세는 설명에서 빠짐
anomalies.what: The trailing effective rate of {tax_rate.effective_rate|pct} includes fiscal 2025, whose provision was a net benefit of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.income_tax_expense.parts.prior_fiscal_year.value}. The year-to-date provision rose to {terms.trailing_four_quarters.income_tax_expense.parts.this_year_to_date.value} from {terms.trailing_four_quarters.income_tax_expense.parts.prior_year_to_date.value}. The note and MD&A credit pretax income alone and leave out the newly footnoted global minimum tax payable.

anomalies.name: Excise tax reversal raises year-to-date income
anomalies.name_ko: 소비세 충당 환입으로 누적 이익 증가
anomalies.what: Year-to-date other income includes a gain from reversing VMware excise tax charges after the final regulations. It raises GAAP income once, and the release excludes it from non-GAAP. The calculator has no field for its amount, so no earnings adjustment is written.

anomalies.name: Near-term share of the backlog lowered
anomalies.name_ko: 수주잔고 중 단기 인식 비중 하향
anomalies.what: Remaining performance obligations rose, but management cut the share it expects to recognize within the next year. This is a changed timing estimate that lowers expected near-term revenue from the backlog; it does not raise income. No calculator field carries either figure.

anomalies.name: Restructuring charges recur in every period read
anomalies.name_ko: 구조조정 비용이 매 기간 반복
anomalies.what: Restructuring and impairment charges are tagged in this quarter, the year-ago quarter and both year-to-date periods, and the release adds them back to non-GAAP income each time. A charge present in every period read is an operating cost; the VMware integration is the benign reading.

anomalies.name: Non-GAAP to GAAP gap cannot be measured
anomalies.name_ko: 비GAAP·GAAP 이익 차이 측정 불가
anomalies.what: The release prints GAAP and non-GAAP earnings with stock-based compensation, amortization and restructuring added back. No us-gaap concept carries the non-GAAP figure, so the gap cannot be measured or trended in any period.

anomalies.name: Soft-asset share at its lowest in the table
anomalies.name_ko: 무형 성격 자산 비중이 기록상 최저
anomalies.what: Soft assets are {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share|pct} of total assets, the lowest of the filled quarters, against {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.soft_asset_share|pct} at the end of fiscal 2024. This departs from the company's past in the clean direction, as acquisition intangibles amortize and cash builds.

anomalies.name: New guarantee of a customer's AI-rack lease payments
anomalies.name_ko: 고객 AI 랙 리스료에 대한 신규 보증
anomalies.what: A guarantee with a tagged maximum of {terms.balances_now.guarantee_maximum_exposure} appeared in the quarter; none is tagged at the year-earlier date. The company covers the shortfall between a share of the lease amounts owed and the racks' resale value, may have to assume the lease, and says it may enter similar arrangements.

anomalies.name: Purchase obligations far above their year-earlier level
anomalies.name_ko: 구매약정이 한 해 전보다 크게 증가
anomalies.what: Unrecorded unconditional purchase obligations are {terms.balances_now.unconditional_purchase_obligations} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.unconditional_purchase_obligations} a year earlier, larger than trailing cost of revenue of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.cost_of_revenue}, and fall mostly in the first and second years of the schedule. Neither report explains the change.

anomalies.name: Customer convertible notes as a route to vendor financing
anomalies.name_ko: 고객 전환사채를 통한 벤더 금융 경로
anomalies.what: The customer may issue the company convertible notes whose proceeds must go to its lease obligations; none had been issued at quarter end. If notes are issued, company cash would leave through investing while product receipts arrive through operating, lifting operating cash flow. The reports give no terms, and the calculator has no field.

anomalies.name: Factoring proceeds in operating cash flow, amount not measurable
anomalies.name_ko: 영업현금흐름에 포함된 팩토링 대금, 금액 측정 불가
anomalies.what: Proceeds from non-recourse factoring sit in operating cash flow. The year-to-date volume is below the prior year's, so factoring is not what lifts this year's cash growth. The concept is untagged, so terms.trailing_four_quarters.proceeds_from_sale_of_receivables is missing and no amount can be measured or adjusted.

anomalies.name: Share-based compensation well above its earlier years
anomalies.name_ko: 주식보상비용이 과거보다 크게 높음
anomalies.what: Share-based compensation is {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation} over the trailing four quarters, against {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.2.share_based_compensation} in fiscal 2023, though the quarter's expense fell from the year-ago quarter. It is a real cost and is already subtracted in free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted ({free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted}).

anomalies.name: Withholding taxes on vesting now settled by share sales instead of cash
anomalies.name_ko: 주식 보상 원천징수를 현금 대신 주식 매각으로 정산
anomalies.what: Withholding taxes on vesting are now settled by selling part of the vested shares, where in the prior year the company paid them in cash. The cost moves from a financing outflow to dilution. Operating cash flow is unaffected, and the calculator carries no withholding line.

anomalies.name: Officer-change 8-K filings not visible
anomalies.name_ko: 임원 변경 8-K 본문 미확인
anomalies.what: The 8-K list includes officer-or-director-change filings in March 2026 and April 2026 and other-events filings in June 2026 and July 2026, and their bodies are not in my inputs. A finance-officer departure cannot be ruled out; the 10-Q shows the chief financial officer in office.

anomalies.name: Net income and interest expense tags switch across periods
anomalies.name_ko: 순이익·이자비용 태그가 기간마다 바뀜
anomalies.what: The filed annual history moves net income between ProfitLoss and NetIncomeLoss across years, and the interest-expense tag differs between the fiscal year and the year-to-date periods. These are tag changes, not restatements, but they stop the accrual trend from being compared year on year.

anomalies.name: Guarantee disclosure relocated and counterparty renamed
anomalies.name_ko: 보증 공시 위치 이동 및 거래상대방 명칭 변경
anomalies.what: The Backstop moved from a subsequent-event paragraph into a new guarantee heading, and its counterparty changed from 'investor partner' to 'financial partner'. Meanwhile the controls item reports no change in internal control in the quarter the arrangement was entered.

anomalies.name: Earnings release silent on the Backstop and the financing platform
anomalies.name_ko: 실적 발표문이 보증과 금융 플랫폼을 언급하지 않음
anomalies.what: The release's figures match the 10-Q, but it says nothing about the AI XPV platform, the Backstop, the customer notes or counterparty credit risk, while the 10-Q tags {terms.balances_now.guarantee_maximum_exposure} of guarantee exposure.

anomalies.name: Segment expenses tagged at the release's non-GAAP amounts
anomalies.name_ko: 부문 비용이 발표문의 비GAAP 금액으로 태그됨
anomalies.what: The segment-axis research and development and SG&A facts equal the release's non-GAAP lines, not the GAAP lines. A benign reading is that the segment measure is the one management reviews, which excludes stock-based compensation and amortization; the reports do not say.

anomalies.name: MD&A describes a wider platform than the notes
anomalies.name_ko: MD&A가 주석보다 넓은 플랫폼 범위를 기술
anomalies.what: MD&A names a platform sized in gigawatts, an initial tranche and possible residual value guarantees; the commitments note describes one arrangement and no residual value guarantee.

anomalies.name: Vendor-financed AI-rack structure supporting demand
anomalies.name_ko: 수요를 떠받치는 벤더 금융형 AI 랙 구조
anomalies.what: A financial partner buys racks built on the company's accelerators and leases them to a customer. The company backstops the lease payments and may hold the customer's notes, whose proceeds go to those payments, and MD&A says the platform bridges the gap between the customer labs' cash flows and their investment needs. Demand rests partly on the company's own credit.

anomalies.name: Customer concentration rising
anomalies.name_ko: 고객 집중도 상승
anomalies.what: The tagged major customer's share of revenue rose from {concentration.facts.0.value|pct} in fiscal 2023 to {concentration.facts.1.value|pct} and then {concentration.facts.3.value|pct}. MD&A now gives a single distributor a larger share of quarterly revenue and puts the top five end customers at a majority.

anomalies.name: Rising distributor share alongside lengthening receivable days
anomalies.name_ko: 유통사 비중 상승과 매출채권 회수일수 증가가 동반
anomalies.what: A distributor is taking a rising share of revenue while receivable days stand near their high at {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}, and the major customer's receivable share ({concentration.facts.4.value|pct}) exceeds its revenue share. That is the channel-loading pattern. Neither report gives distributor inventory, sell-through or return rights, so it cannot be tested further.

anomalies.name: Inventory built for expected rather than ordered shipments
anomalies.name_ko: 확정 주문이 아닌 예상 출하를 위한 재고 축적
anomalies.what: Inventory is {terms.balances_now.inventory} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.inventory} a year earlier, built for expected rather than ordered shipments. Quarterly days of inventory ({trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory}) exceed the year-ago figure ({trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory}). No inventory reserve or write-down is tagged, so obsolescence cannot be tested.

summary_ko.earnings_versus_cash: 최근 네 분기 영업현금흐름은 순이익의 {earnings_versus_cash.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}배로 여전히 이익보다 많지만, 회사가 공시한 과거 어느 회계연도보다 낮다. 이번 분기 순이익은 전년 동기보다 {ratios.growth.net_income.year_over_year|pct} 늘었으나 영업현금흐름은 {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.year_over_year|pct} 늘었고, 매출채권 증가가 순이익의 {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.share_of_net_income|pct}를 흡수했다.
summary_ko.revenue_recognition: 분기 매출채권 회수일수는 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}일로 과거보다 길어졌고, 매출이 느는 동안 계약부채 비율은 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue|pct}로 기록상 가장 낮아졌다. 소프트웨어 계약에서 해지권이 빠지면서 라이선스 매출을 계약기간에 나누지 않고 한꺼번에 먼저 인식하게 되어, 매출이 청구와 현금보다 앞서 잡히고 있다.
summary_ko.estimates_and_reserves: 경영진은 최대 {terms.balances_now.guarantee_maximum_exposure} 규모 리스 보증의 공정가치를 '중요하지 않다'고 판단했지만 근거를 공개하지 않았다. 최근 네 분기 유효세율 {tax_rate.effective_rate|pct}는 전년도 세금 환급 효과에 일부 기대고 있으며, 대손·재고·보증 충당금은 태그가 없어 검증할 수 없다.
summary_ko.cost_deferral: 비용을 자산으로 돌린 흔적은 없고, 무형 성격 자산 비중은 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share|pct}로 오히려 낮아졌다. 다만 일회성으로 빼는 구조조정 비용이 매 기간 반복되고, 비GAAP 이익과 GAAP 이익의 차이는 계산할 수 없다.
summary_ko.cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh: 재무상태표 밖에 {terms.balances_now.guarantee_maximum_exposure} 규모의 보증이 새로 생겼고, 구매약정은 한 해 전 {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.unconditional_purchase_obligations}에서 {terms.balances_now.unconditional_purchase_obligations}로 불어났다. 매출채권 팩토링 대금이 영업현금흐름에 들어가지만 금액 필드가 없어 조정하지 않았고, 주식보상비용 {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation}은 이미 품질조정 잉여현금흐름에서 빠져 있다.
summary_ko.controls_audit_and_filing_signals: 공시통제가 유효하다는 결론은 유지되었고, 지연 제출이나 숨은 재작성은 보이지 않는다. 다만 임원 변경 관련 8-K 본문이 입력에 없어 재무 담당 임원이 떠났는지는 확인할 수 없다.
